notes.title: Chapter 2: Update 0.95.554
notes.content:
[p]Dear friends, [/p][p align="justify"]This update is primarily dedicated to fixes. We were able to pay special attention to issues that required refactoring to resolve. Our other area of focus was the UX component.[/p][h3]Fixed[/h3][list][*][p align="justify"](Hotbar) Items disappearing from the quick access panel when switching between servers. Also, if an item that was in your hotbar disappears from your inventory, its slot will become dimmed, but when that item reappears in your inventory, it will automatically be pulled back to that hotbar slot;[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"](Real Estate) Fixed a rarely occurring asynchrony in saving items in chests and the character's inventory, which could lead to item loss;[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]Returned additional mob names;[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]Fazira Golem got stuck in the walls they spawned;[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]ATL-3160 - Detailed information about server shutdowns for maintenance;[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]ATL-3332 - Powders would disappear when brewing with full inventory;[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]ATL-3319 - A player with invulnerability could attack a player without invulnerability;[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]ATL-3352 - If an Archmage activated levitation while sprinting, being in the air consumed energy;[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]ATL-3392 - Loot bags got stuck in trees;[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]Mouse focus after moving with unallocated redistribution points;[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]Tax money is forcibly dropped from the inventory, regardless of zone and karma;[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]Duplicate map marker names;[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]Descriptions of some equipment item names;[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]The “Hit the Anvil” ability no longer drains caster’s energy;[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]A number of minor warnings in the client logs;[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]A number of errors from the previous patch (throwing away recipe books, skin processing, group window);[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]Localization;[/p][/*][/list][h3]Promo Code Mechanics[/h3][p]We have prepared a mechanic that allows influencers (in the broad sense) to provide in-game and social bonuses for their audience through promo codes.[/p][p]
[/p][p]After activating a promo code, rewards are sent to the player's mail.[/p][p]
[/p][p]The peculiarity of our approach is as follows:[/p][list][*][p]Promo codes have several levels;[/p][/*][*][p]Advancing a promo code to a new level provides everyone who activated that promo code with additional rewards;[/p][/*][*][p]Reaching a new level depends on the number of activations;[/p][/*][*][p]Those who activated the code first will automatically receive the reward in their mail when new levels are reached;[/p][/*][/list][h3]UX[/h3][list][*][p]Inventory and pouch widgets have been combined into one widget (window), new expansion shapes have been added for more comfortable management;[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]Items dropped from the inventory remain in the world for 5 minutes instead of 2.5;[/p][/*][/list][h3]Forest AI Update (Menadas and Stickmen)[/h3][list][*][p align="justify"]Stickmen and Menadas of different types have received updates to their stats and behavior to make the interaction experience with them more individual:[/p][list][*][p align="justify"]Pine:[/p][list][*][p align="justify"]General: Less HP and Defense, but more Attack;[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]Stickmen: A successful attack has a 30% chance to apply an attack buff to the Stickman, which stacks up to 3 times;[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]Menada: Successful hits with a small projectile apply a Physical and Magic Resistance debuff on the target, which stacks up to 5 times;[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p align="justify"]Redwood:[/p][list][*][p align="justify"]General: Average values of all characteristics;[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]Stickmen: Deals damage with an explosion of needles around itself at the end of the defense animation;[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]Menada: After escaping with a slow, applies a buff to itself that deals damage with needles around it every few seconds;[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p align="justify"]Oak:[/p][list][*][p align="justify"]General: Increased Defense and Health, decreased Speed;[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]Stickmen: Each successful attack has a 30% chance to immobilize for 1 sec;[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p align="justify"]Birch:[/p][list][*][p align="justify"]General: Significantly less HP, less Defense, and more Attack;[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]Stickmen: While in defense, releases pollen that deals damage to Energy and prevents its recovery for 5 seconds;[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]Menada: When escaping, applies not only a slow debuff but also a restriction on HP and MP recovery;[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]Added[/h3][list][*][p align="justify"]In anticipation of changes to the mine concept and the addition of the T2-T3 underworld, a spawn of rare metal nuggets has been added along the river in Gwaelot county near the town of Lynland:[/p][list][*][p align="justify"]Nuggets alway drops on death;[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]Nuggets can be directly processed into rare metal dust by special characters marked on the map with an icon of metal ingots;[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p align="justify"]A second town in Gwaelot county—Lynland;[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]New rooms in the towns of Gwaelot;[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]Minimaps for towns in Gwaelot;[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]Portals and tokens to teleport to Gwaelot towns;[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]A restriction to withdraw taxes during the white phase in castles;[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p align="justify"]Best regards,[/p][p align="justify"]Atlant Games Team[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Chapter 2: Update 0.95.510
notes.content: [p]Dear friends,[/p][p]In this update, we focused on implementing changes to the castle siege procedure, as outlined in our roadmap. These changes aim to make sieges more dynamic and user-friendly. We also revisited the concept of concentrated powders. It is now limited to one stage, but R1 powders have received enhanced characteristics, balanced by additional crafting requirements.[/p][p][/p][h3]Siege Mechanics[/h3][list][*][p]Enabled the players to choose a destination point when using tokens to teleport to the castle:[/p][list][*][p]Members of attacking guilds can select one of the points around the castle;[/p][/*][*][p]Castle owners are automatically transported to the courtyard behind the castle walls;[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The red phase variance has been changed to ±5 minutes of real time (instead of ±20%);[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to switch between game time and real time in the castle filling window;[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the display of the current phase via the castle pillar;[/p][/*][*][p]Changes to the capture procedure:[/p][list][*][p]To capture a castle, you must capture 2 points inside the castle and the Donjon (forts are excluded);[/p][/*][*][p]1 fort opens 1 gate; capturing the castle doesn’t require to burn both;[/p][/*][*][p]In the future, we will reintroduce the functionality of dugouts: they will allow castle defenders to quickly move from the courtyard to the forts;[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The castle capture widget now works at all times and shows the current progress everywhere around the castle;[/p][/*][*][p]Added a warning when attempting to fill an enemy castle;[/p][/*][*][p]Notifications about kills and kill streaks during castle sieges;[/p][/*][*][p]Increased seamless zones around T2 castles to better match their sizes;[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h3]Concentrated Powders[/h3][list][*][p]New bonuses to characteristics that powders get when concentrated:[/p][list][*][p]Regular buffs:[/p][list][*][p]Persistence upon death;[/p][/*][*][p]Duration increased by +20%;[/p][/*][*][p]Stat reduction: -15%;[/p][/*][*][p]Cleansing resistance increased by +1;[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Combat powders:[/p][list][*][p]Damage increased by +30% (percentage of the difference between the current level and the next);[/p][/*][*][p]Speed increased by +30%;[/p][/*][*][p]Range increased by +30%;[/p][/*][*][p]Requirements increased by +50% (percentage of the difference between the current level and the next); [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Healing powders:[/p][list][*][p]Active healing:[/p][list][*][p]+20% min. value;[/p][/*][*][p]Mana requirements reduced by -25%;[/p][/*][*][p]Attribute requirements increased by +50%;[/p][/*][*][p]Range increased by +30%;[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Passive healing (Regeneration, Meditation):[/p][list][*][p]Persistence upon death;[/p][/*][*][p]+20% min. value;[/p][/*][*][p]+25% duration;[/p][/*][*][p]Resistance increased by +1;[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Brewing concentrated powders is now 22% more effective;[/p][/*][*][p]Added unified brushwood requirements for powder brewing, increasing with level:[/p][list][*][p]Lvl. 1 — 2  firewood;[/p][/*][*][p]Lvl. 2 — 4  firewood;[/p][/*][*][p]Lvl. 3 — 6  firewood;[/p][/*][*][p]Lvl. 4 — 8  firewood;[/p][/*][*][p]Lvl. 5 — 11  firewood;[/p][/*][*][p]Lvl. 6 — 13  firewood;[/p][/*][*][p]Lvl. 7 — 16  firewood;[/p][/*][*][p]Lvl. 8 — 20  firewood;[/p][/*][*][p]Lvl. 9 — 24  firewood.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]Druid[/h3][p]In the previous update, we attempted to address the Druid balance issues through less restrictive measures. Having seen that this didn't produce the desired effect, we're now reverting to the stricter limitations originally planned. Whether temporarily or not, this update introduces [b]a restriction allowing only one Druid per party[/b].[/p][p]We sincerely hope this measure will prove to be strictly temporary. In upcoming patches, we'll continue working on Druid balance adjustments to eventually eliminate the need for such restrictions altogether.[/p][p][/p][h3]Added[/h3][list][*][p]NPCs for T2 seal processing and herb treaters in the counties of Unsund and Gwaelot:[/p][list][*][p]T2 seal processors allow the use of T2 mob trophies to obtain more seals;[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Updated teleportation points for all castles;[/p][/*][*][p]Added new icons for token boxes;[/p][/*][*][p]Increased mob levels in T3 counties to 40-60 (boss levels remain unchanged until T10-T12 equipment is introduced);[/p][/*][*][p]Added a hint about reaching level 10.10 during the portal stage in the tutorial;[/p][/*][*][p]Unified armor and weapon names.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Optimization and unification of general master materials and object master materials in villages;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the coal material in the campfire (especially noticeable in the starting village);[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]Best regards,[/p][p]Atlant Games Team[/p][p] [/p]

notes.title: Chapter 2: Update 0.95.468
notes.content:
[p]Dear friends,[/p][p]This patch includes the July event, bug fixes, druid adjustments, and the ability to change character appearance and name.[/p][p]
[/p][h3]Continuing the Celebration[/h3][p]Apart from daily rewards, we’d like to introduce the new event:[/p][list][*][p]Added event coins to loot from AI (excluding bosses) across the landmass of Dwarrhan and Fazira;[/p][/*][*][p]Coin drop chance is equal for all AI levels;[/p][/*][*][p]Cities now feature an NPC (marked with unique map icon) who exchanges coins for event rewards;[/p][/*][*][p]Current event rewards (to be expanded later):[/p][list][*][p]Tender Souffle;[/p][/*][*][p]“Pack Bull” powder;[/p][/*][*][p]“Learning” powder;[/p][/*][*][p]Phantom Cauldron IX:[/p][/*][*][p]Phantom Armorer’s Tools IX;[/p][/*][*][p]Phantom Weaponsmith’s Tools IX;[/p][/*][*][p]Phantom Enchanter’s Tools IX.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]Druid Changes[/h3][p]Before implementing more drastic measures against overhealing in multi-druid groups, we're testing these adjustments:[/p][list][*][p]All druid powders now consume 25 energy (regardless of type/level);[/p][/*][*][p]"Rite" Powder: Effectiveness -30%, Mana cost +15%;[/p][/*][*][p]"Totem" Powder: Radius -30%, Cooldown +10%, Mana cost +20%;[/p][/*][*][p]"Panacea" Powder: Projectile speed +100%, Range -20%, Cooldown -20%, Cast time is now instant, mana cost is +10%, and there is a new icon.[/p][/*][*][p]New "Mass Healing" Powder (AOE-targeted):[/p][list][*][p]15 m range, 7.5m radius[/p][/*][*][p]20% less effective than Totem[/p][/*][*][p]1.5s CD, instant cast[/p][/*][*][p]Medium mana cost (between Ritual and Totem)[/p][/*][*][p]Only heals caster if standing in target area[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Nerfed Hoarfrost Cloak of Health: Bonus reduced from 30% to 20%;[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h3]1H and 2H Weapons[/h3][list][*][p](1H) Alternative attack:[/p][list][*][p]Damage bonus decreased by 60%;[/p][/*][*][p]Stamina depletion increased by 5 points;[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p](2H) Weapon:[/p][list][*][p]Damage output increased by 10%;[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p](2H) Sprint attack:[/p][list][*][p]Damage penalty decreased by 40 40%;[/p][/*][*][p]Stamina depletion increased up to 15 points.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]Added[/h3][list][*][p]NPC runemaster on the Mountain Pass;[/p][/*][*][p]Automatic alternative routing now activates if connection issues occur mid-game;[/p][/*][/list][h3]Changes[/h3][list][*][p]Rune processor: Dynamic Vendor Balance (DVB) relaxed by 50%;[/p][/*][*][p]Main menu: Added double-click login for characters, reorganized buttons;[/p][/*][*][p]Rivulet Island: removed unnecessary NPCs and spawners;[/p][/*][*][p]Rivulet Island: character collision is disabled acrros the bridge leading from the starting area;[/p][/*][*][p]World map: Gwaelot tier/color updated to "III" (other changes later);[/p][/*][/list][h3]Fixes[/h3][list][*][p](Server) Critical Harbur crash (rare); [/p][/*][*][p]Portal functionality issues;[/p][/*][*][p]Mail reward claim bug during rapid clicking;[/p][/*][*][p]Fazira invulnerability exploit;[/p][/*][*][p]Localization errors;[/p][/*][/list][h3]Visual Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Settlement object materials (villages);[/p][/*][*][p]Artistic consistency for updated settlement textures[/p][/*][*][p]Water interaction (preparing for swimming mechanics)[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h3]In-Game Store[/h3][p]Added:[/p][list][*][p]Name change tokens;[/p][/*][*][p]Appearance change tokens;[/p][/*][/list][p][i]Usage: Apply the item in inventory, then return to the main menu and edit any character's name/appearance.[/i][/p][p]
[/p][p]Best regards,[/p][p]The Atlant Games Team[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Fazira Weekend
notes.content:
Dear friends!

We understand perfectly well that the long-awaited summer season has begun, as well as the vacation season, and not everyone will want to dive into the frosty Fazira.

Nevertheless, [b]we cannot do without apologizing[/b] for the problems with the update, as well as the absence of these events in the last 2 days.

Therefore, we invite everyone to the event Fazira:
[list] [*]portals will be open to all comers for several days;[/*] [*]start: scheduled server reboot, [b]June 12[/b];[/*] [*]end: Monday evening, [b]June 16[/b];[/*] [/list]
We remind you that the event Fazira has the following bonuses:
[list] [*]increased experience (+150%);[/*] [*]increased coin drop (+25%);[/*] [*]increased cloak drop (+10%);[/*] [*]"Freeze" powder added to loot from creatures;[/*] [*]more profitable exchange of herbs at NPC exchanger;[/*] [/list]
Best regards,

The Atlant Games Team

notes.title: Chapter 2: Update 0.95.396
notes.content:
Dear friends!

This is an interim but very important update.
[h3]Vocation Movement Speed[/h3]
A number of Vocations were given a passive speed boost:
[list] [*]Physical Vocations (except Hunter): +10%;[/*] [*]Universal Vocations: +5%;[/*] [*]Magical Vocations: 0%, except for Necromancer. notes.title: Chapter 2: Update 0.95.363
notes.content:
Dear friends,

This update includes the main objective of Chapter 2: the damage formula and other changes in PvE damage calculation.
[h3]Tutorial 2.0[/h3]
Added technical buffs for new characters:
[list] [*]“Rookie” karma level:[/*][list] [*]No experience or item loss upon death (except "red" items);[/*] [*]Killing a character with such karma level decreases karma by 1000 points;[/*] [*]Removed upon reaching level 31 or after killing 3 characters;[/*] [/list]  [*]Tax Exemption:[/*][list] [*]Exempts players from paying castle taxes;[/*] [*]Removed upon reaching level 21;[/*] [/list]  [/list][h3]T2 County: Unsund[/h3][list] [*]Added 2 settlements:[/*][list] [*]Added T7-T9 powder merchants;[/*] [*]Added T4-T6 equipment merchants;[/*] [/list]  [*]Planned for the near future:[/*][list] [*]Settlement minimaps;[/*] [*]Addition of T7-T9 equipment merchants, quest givers, and other NPCs;[/*] [*]Real estate;[/*] [/list]  [/list][h3]Damage Formula 2.0 (General and PvP)[/h3]
A complete overhaul of the damage formula with several changes/fixes:
[list] [*]Formula no longer smooths out significant advantages of attack over defense;[/*] [*]Removed effective melee weapon range and hidden additional critical damage chance stats;[/*] [*]Minimum damage when defense exceeds attack is now simply "1" (was 10% of attack value), with simplified attack/defense comparison;[/*] [*]Body parts and hitboxes:[/*][list] [*]Head/neck hits: pull weapon damage toward MAX attack value and add damage multiplier ONLY to weapon attack (x1.5 crossbow, x1.4 melee, x1.45 magic);[/*] [*]Torso/arms: No modifiers;[/*] [*]Leg hits: pull towards MIN weapon attack, multiplier (x0.8 crossbow, x0.9 magic), energy drain increased 2-2.5x;[/*] [*]Improved and fixed hitboxes for male and (significantly) female characters;[/*] [/list]  [*]Powder heating: Fixed incorrect bonus calculation. Heating bonus now only affects powder's own attack value but stacks with headshot bonus;[/*] [*][u]Planned for the near future:[/u][/*][list] [*]Balance adjustments for new formula;[/*] [*]Rework of minimum damage to move away from "1" damage;[/*] [*]Rework of shield interactions with different weapon types, including AOE magic;[/*] [/list]  [/list][h3]Damage Formula 2.0 (PvE and Scaling)[/h3][list] [*]Added a "partial scaling" mechanic when the character level significantly exceeds the AI level:[/*][list] [*]The greater the positive delta between character and AI level, the more attack value the character loses and the AI gains;[/*] [/list]  [*]Fixed formula error causing double attack values for certain AI attacks;[/*] [*]Fixed experience calculation error for killing blows – now considers all attack values instead of just weapon attack;[/*] [*]Due to overlapping new damage formula, scaling mechanic, and AI stat revisions, we apologize in advance for potential artifacts;[/*] [/list][h3]Combat System:[/h3][list] [*]Disabled prediction system for melee weapons:[/*][list] [*]Client now always waits for server response about attack results instead of simulating parallel calculations;[/*] [*]This will add ping-based delay to hit reaction SFX/VFX (hit sounds, blood, crosshair color, weapon recoil animation, etc.)[/*] [*]But eliminates discrepancies between client/server calculations (where client showed hit but server registered miss)[/*] [/list]  [*]Fixed crosshair focus issue when target is in range;[/*] [*]Increased melee weapon recoil animation speed;[/*] [/list][h3]Disenchantment Changes[/h3][list] [*]The concept of "disenchanting" has been removed along with its overly strict rules;[/*] [*]Enchanted items can now be re-enchanted without prior disenchanting;[/*] [*]However, re-enchanting requires a recipe of EQUAL OR HIGHER quality than the item;[/*] [*]Initial enchanting still allows using lower-quality recipes with risk of failure and item breakage;[/*] [/list][h3]Changes[/h3][list] [*]Increased sprint speed in Red and Black zones by 11% (now 4.8 m/s);[/*] [*]Increased crossbow bolt speed and flatness by 20%;[/*] [*]Reduced radius of Air magic S_/M_ missiles by 10% and 15%, respectively;[/*] [*]Increased Shroom spawners in Daerkunn, Unsund, and Oer;[/*] [*]Removed Vocational quest CD;[/*] [*]“Tax Evader” karma now gives the same penalties as “Bad” karma; [/*] [/list][h3]Optimization[/h3][list] [*]Various background sublevel loading improvements;[/*] [*]Loading screen no longer disappears prematurely;[/*] [/list]
Best regards,

The Atlant Games Team

notes.title: Hotfix of patch 0.95.222 and Balance Changes
notes.content:
Dear friends,

In addition to fixing the crash issue that occurred in some cases during the first launch, we’ve also addressed yesterday’s controversial changes, which were met with mixed reactions:
[list] [*]In PvP, the increased speed was, to put it mildly, received poorly;[/*] [*]While for non-PvP situations it was received well;[/*] [/list]
We’ve prepared a series of changes for testing this week and will gather feedback by the end of the week
[h3]Our Plans[/h3]

notes.title: Update 0.95.222
notes.content:
Dear friends,

We apologize for the ongoing issues with quests, but below we will explain why resolving the problems with quest completion has taken longer than expected. The primary reason was the critical need to address another issue—connectivity to servers in the EU region.

We also remind you that the main focus of the current chapter is a complete refactor and reconceptualization of the tutorial, to which we are dedicating nearly all of our team's resources.
[h3]Anniversary[/h3]
We’ll start these patch notes with gifts celebrating the early access anniversary:
[list] [*]Warming Brew х3 per character;[/*] [*]Anniversary Cake x10 per character;[/*] [*]Token: Mountain Pass x3 per character;[/*] [*]Phantom Major Learning x5 per account;[/*] [*]Special Cloak Skin;[/*] [/list]
[u]You can claim the reward within a week after the update![/u]
[h3]EU Region and Alternative Routing[/h3]
The EU region, as part of the initial concept, remains distributed across servers in data centers in Germany, Russia, and Finland.

Due to circumstances beyond our control—well known to many—issues arose with connectivity to certain locations.

We’ve prepared our own solution for routing to game servers, which, based on our tests, allows seamless connection without a VPN while preserving those precious milliseconds.

[b]Activation is done manually in the main menu.[/b]
[h3]Quests[/h3][list] [*]The new quest system has received multiple improvements, along with detailed logging for faster bug fixes;[/*] [*]Fixed the issue with quest activation probability (availability);[/*] [*]Fixed quest tracking in the new system;[/*] [*]Added guaranteed (always available) mob-killing quests;[/*] [*]The gradual migration of quests to the new system continues;[/*] [*]Completely reworked hide quests based on the mob-killing concept (description below);[/*] [*]Fixed an issue with the reroll timer deviation (the event determining quest availability and rewards) for mob-killing quests, which caused a gradual increase in the frequency of this event;[/*] [/list][h3]Fazira | Mountain Pass[/h3][list] [*]Reworked the mountain pass leading to Fazira.;[/*] [*]Added a teleportation token to the entrance of Fazira (almost to the entrance). NPCs for creating the token are located in Anthernolle and Oergrad;[/*] [*]   • Added a blizzard to the event version of Phazira. This weather condition:[/*][list] [*]Has its own distinct visual design;[/*] [*]Applies a negative effect to the character (v1);[/*] [*]To remove the negative effect, characters can warm up by campfires or use warming items;[/*] [/list]  [/list][h3]Movement Speed | Energy[/h3][list] [*]Character movement speed increased by 14%.[/*] [*]Additionally, sprint speed increased by another 16% (a total of 32%).[/*] [*]Sprinting will consume more energy;[/*] [*]Fixed the visual mismatch between female character animation speed and movement speed;[/*] [/list][h3]Changes[/h3][list] [*]Removed the restriction on using items during combat (now only equipment changes are restricted);[/*] [*]Added a sprint restriction for all medium (M) attack powders during casting (similar to AOE attack powders);[/*] [*]Added a weapon swap restriction during dodge;[/*] [*]Replaced the VFX for the "Meteor" magic spell;[/*] [*]Invulnerability upon spawning in Black Zones now follows the same rules as in Red Zones, meaning stricter conditions for losing invulnerability; [/*] [/list][h3]Miscellaneous[/h3][list] [*]Localization fixes;[/*] [/list][h3](Footnote) Settlement Quest Features[/h3]
[b]Hide Quests Changes - general:[/b]
[list] [*]The average quest reward has been increased by 35%;[/*] [*]Each settlement favors two types of mobs: quests for these mobs become active 10% more often and offer 10% higher rewards;[/*] [*]Rewards for hare hides have been increased several times;[/*] [*]Quests with the highest rewards are given by hunters in remote areas, followed by city hunters, and then village hunters;[/*] [/list]
[b]Settlement-Specific Features:[/b]
[list] [*]Anthernolle and Dyrivoy:[/*][list] [*]High rewards with high variance;[/*] [*]Medium quest activation chance;[/*] [*]Medium DQB stability;[/*] [/list]  [*]Isgollyne and Harbur:[/*][list] [*]High chance of "bulk" quests appearing;[/*] [*]Highest rewards and highest variance;[/*] [*]Low DQB stability;[/*] [*]Medium quest activation chance;[/*] [/list]  [*]Camlasse and Buddre:[/*][list] [*]Medium rewards and variance;[/*] [*]Medium DQB stability;[/*] [*]Medium quest activation chance;[/*] [/list]  [*]Oergrad and Reniche:[/*][list] [*]High quest resistance to DQB;[/*] [*]High quest activation chance;[/*] [*]Low rewards and variance;[/*] [/list]  [*]Oer’s Wilderness:[/*][list] [*]Bulk quests with medium rewards;[/*] [/list]  [*]Brabat’s Wilderness:[/*][list] [*]High rewards;[/*] [*]Unstable DQB;[/*] [/list]  [*]Gwasgar’s Wilderness[/*][list] [*]High DQB stability;[/*] [*]Low reward;[/*] [/list]  [*]Daerkunn’s Wilderness:[/*][list] [*]Medium stability;[/*] [*]Medium rewards.[/*] [/list]  [/list]
Best regards,

The Atlant Games Team

notes.content:
This update is primarily focused on experience (XP) and a number of important fixes.
[h3]Experience[/h3][list] [*]Experience Redirection Powders have been completely reworked with new logic:[/*][list] [*]Now they convert all received XP into the specified attribute;[/*] [*]Only one powder can be used at a time (they will override each other);[/*] [*]Merchants selling these powders have been added to all cities, not just Isgollyne;[/*] [/list]  [*]New Experience Boost Powders have been added in 2 types:[/*][list] [*]Regular and Phantom Learning powders;[/*] [*]Both types have 3 levels: +15%, +30%, and +50%;[/*] [*]Different types can stack (e.g., you can use both a regular and a Phantom powder at the same time);[/*] [*]Levels within the same type cannot stack (they overwrite each other).[/*] [/list]  [*]+30% XP for Everyone:[/*][list] [*]For every 1 hour of offline time, the character receives a +30% XP buff (Learning) for 5 minutes, up to a maximum of 1 hour in total;[/*] [*]If the character had a +30% buff with less than 1 hour remaining when logging out, it will be extended to 1 hour;[/*] [*]If the character had a +15% or +50% buff when logging out, the offline bonus will not be applied;[/*] [/list]  [*]Where to Get Powders:[/*][list] [*](temporarily) Regular powders can be exchanged for Seals at NPCs;[/*] [*]With the introduction of the new location (Blazing Forest), they will be crafted with Rune Shards;[/*] [*]Phantom powders have been added to the in-game store;[/*] [/list]  [*]Fixed the main issue with incorrect XP distribution in parties when members have redirection effects;[/*] [*]What’s Next:[/*][list] [*]XP events (weekends, holidays, etc.);[/*] [*]Event locations with bonus XP;[/*] [*]Castle runes for XP;[/*] [/list]  [/list][h3]Fixed[/h3][list] [*]Display of effects in buff tooltips;[/*] [*]Display of HP/MP/Energy regeneration modifiers in tooltips and correct values in the combat log;  [/*] [*]Combat log saving;[/*] [*]Order of letters indicating item quality in the exchange window and powder crafting window;[/*] [*]Display of stats when linking enchanted items in chat;[/*] [*]Incorrect disappearance of nameplates on character death;[/*] [*]Fixed the display of map markers on opposite continents;[/*] [/list][h3]Changed[/h3][list] [*]The NPC (quest giver) who exchanged Frost Leaf in Fazira has been replaced with an NPC (processor) for easier handling of large quantities;[/*] [/list][h3]Herb Spawns[/h3][list] [*](Temporarily) Disabled the ecosystem on herb spawners, which could lead to a "bad harvest" until the end of the in-game month.[/*] [*]Increased the number of herbs in Dwarrhan by 3 to 14 times.[/*] [*]Increased mushroom spawns in craters and swamps by 2 to 5 times, adjusted respawn cooldowns and variety.[/*][list] [*]We are monitoring the situation with herb-selling NPCs, but we remind you that these vendors were introduced as an expensive alternative to gathering herbs in the open world. Our changes aim to encourage player-to-player trading rather than trading with NPCs by increasing plant availability in Dwarrhan.[/*] [/list]  [/list][h3]Castles[/h3][list] [*]Fort burning:[/*][list] [*]When expensive runes are placed in castles, the burning time for forts has been increased to 5 minutes for regular castles (levels 15 and 45) and 10 minutes for royal castles (levels 30 and 60);[/*] [/list]  [*]Elixirs:[/*][list] [*]Duration of regular elixirs increased to 24 hours;[/*] [*]Duration of royal elixirs increased to 72 hours;[/*] [/list]  [/list]

The Atlant Games Team

[h3]Fixed[/h3][list] [*]Cooldown reset on some vocationsl skills;[/*] [*](NA location) Certain buffs disappeared when moving between servers;[/*] [*]Added a safety measure against losing resources when processing large volumes of resources (in case of failure, items are returned to inventory);[/*] [*](Client) Cause of rare crashes (in-game time);[/*] [*]Levitating objects in several locations;[/*] [*]Localization;[/*] [/list][h3]Optimized[/h3][list] [*](Client) Micro-freezes related to nameplate handling;[/*] [*](Client) Performance loss when equipping certain powders, equipping certain items, and reloading crossbows;[/*] [*](Client) Performance loss due to combat log spam;[/*] [*](Client) Performance loss when characters die on the server;[/*] [/list][h3]Dispel[/h3][list] [*]Added a restriction on using all dispels in Green Zones, except those that can only be cast on oneself (Apprentice Purification);[/*] [*](Temporary) Until the introduction of R2 buff powders, R1 dispels no longer remove R1 buffs;[/*][list] [*]With the introduction of R2 buffs, the dispel system will undergo several changes;[/*] [/list]  [*]All T1 powder vendors in Dwarrhan have been supplied with T0 dispel powders;[/*] [/list][h3]Added[/h3][list] [*]Mini-maps for settlements;[/*] [*]A separate hare spawner with map markers;[/*] [*]Combat log saving when transitioning between servers;[/*] [/list][h3]Changed[/h3][list] [*]Removed time deviation on quest rerolls;[/*] [*]Added seasonal discounts to the in-game store;[/*] [/list][h3]DVB*[/h3]
[u]* Dynamic Vendor Balance: a mechanic that changes the prices of goods and services for each specific NPC based on supply and demand from players.[/u]

Here we publish our response to the lively discussions (data relevant as of the patch note writing):
[list] [*]There are 7 herb vendors in Dwarrhan: the one in Harbur is overloaded by 8.5 times, while the one in Camlasse — by 2.3 times;[/*][list] [*]Herb vendors are an alternative to gathering herbs in the world. It was initially intended that they sell herbs at inflated prices to those who do not want to gather/trade with players;[/*] [/list]  [*]In Dwarrhan, there are 4 metal refining NPCs: in Harbur, they are overloaded by 6.6 times, while in Buddre, their balance remains unchanged.[/*] [/list]
Near-term plans for DVB:
[list] [*]Information about NPC workload, "quality" of quests will be added to trade/processing and quest windows, allowing for quicker assessment of the situation;[/*] [*]The recovery speed for each DVB NPC will be dynamic, making NPCs more unpredictable;[/*] [*]Traders and some processors will be added to Black Zones (whether they will be random is still undecided);[/*] [/list]
Changes to the roadmap will be published in the coming week.

Best regards,
Atlant Games Team

notes.title: Castles: Runes
notes.content:
[h3]What are they?[/h3]
The runes are ancient artifacts that can be used in a castle to gain bonuses for the members of the owner guild.
[h3]Where are they found?[/h3][list] [*]Long ago, they were shattered into large and small shards.[/*] [*]They cannot be found whole and have to be restored at special NPCs:[/*][list] [*]100 small shards can be merged into a big one. One rune requires 3 to 25 lerge shards to restore.[/*] [/list]  [/list][h3]At this point:[/h3][list] [*]Small shards are dropped by regular mobs with a tiny probability and can be found in the open world. Bosses drop more of them and with greater chances;[/*] [*]Large rune shards are also dropped by bosses with little probability.[/*] [/list][h3]What are rune levels and types?[/h3]
Every rune tier (T1-T4) is divided into 4 types:
[list] [*]Base (HP, MP, Energy);[/*] [*]Attack (PA, MA);[/*] [*]Defense (PD, MD);[/*] [*]Miscellaneous (CD reduction, bonus tp carrying capacity);[/*] [/list]
Rune levels affect:
[list] [*]their efficiency depending on castle level where they were activated;[/*] [*]The rune will be less effective the more widely its level differs from that of the castle;[/*] [*]at the  same time, a Т4 rune at its lowest will still be more effective than lower-tier runes;[/*] [/list][h3]Rune Bonus Powers[/h3]
At this stage (with the MAX castle level capped at 60), the bonus from runes ranges from +11.4% to +16.2%, depending on the rune level and its usage efficiency.
[h3]Rune Slots[/h3][list] [*]All characters have 4 rune slots, but 1 character can only take a bonus from 1 rune of a certain type.[/*] [*]Castles have 1 to 3 rune slots depending on the level of the castle:[/*][list] [*]15 lvl = 1 slot, 30 = 2, 45 = 1, 60 = 3;[/*] [*]castle can hold runes of the same types but not identical runes;[/*] [*]the process is irreversible. After putting it in the castle slot, the rune cannot be taken back;[/*] [/list]  [/list][h3]Rune Durability, Activation/Deactivation, Desctruction[/h3][list] [*]Each rune has a durability value that is randomly determined within a specific range at the moment the rune is activated;[/*][list] [*]As a rule, the higher the rune level, the more durability it has;[/*] [*]Durability is depleted when characters interact with the rune ( -1 per 1 use);[/*] [/list]  [*]Activation is the process of placing a rune in a castle, which is currently available to any role within the guild that owns the castle.;[/*] [*]Deactivation is the process of a rune wearing out, which occurs as guild members interact ("Touch") with the rune.;[/*][list] [*]when a rune is deactivated, interaction with it by other guild members becomes impossible (the rune turns a dull color but still occupies a slot in the castle);[/*] [*]it remains active for those who’ve already activated it;[/*] [*]a deactivated rune can then be destroyed;[/*] [/list]  [*]Destruction of the rune occurs by the will of the guild members (Seneschal and above):[/*][list] [*]it dispels the effect and clears the rune slot of the castle;[/*] [/list]  [/list][h3]Rights, Restrictions, and the Rest[/h3][list] [*]In order for the bonus from the rune (in the form of a technical buff) to stay on the character, the following conditions must be met:[/*][list] [*]Be a member of the current guild that owns the castle where the rune was activated;[/*] [*]The rune must not be destroyed;[/*] [*]To interact with the rune, the character must hold the position of vassal or higher;[/*] [/list]  [*]The rune can be activated in the castle during any of its phases;[/*] [*]When the guild that owns the castle changes, the runes remain in the castle;[/*][list] [*]The new owner can interact with the runes or destroy them if the rune has already been deactivated;[/*] [/list]  [*]At this stage, the attack bonuses (PA, MA) will not take into account the weapon in the character's hands;[/*][list] [*]This is intentional, as after the introduction of T4-6 Vocations without T10-12 items, the damage dealt significantly increased, leading to faster-paced duels;[/*] [/list]  [/list][h3]Upcoming Plans[/h3][list] [*]Additional increase/decrease in the effectiveness of the rune depending on whether the character is located within the territory of the castle where it was activated, within its domain, or outside of it;[/*] [*]A unique event boss for castle runes;[/*] [/list]

notes.title: Update 0.95.70
notes.content:
Dear Friends!

January is coming to an end—the New Year trees in ROG, unlike in your homes, have been taken down :) This update brings not only the complex and large-scale mechanics of castle runes but also our efforts in balancing existing content and adding new types of powders.

And of course, we took some time between working on runes to fix long-standing issues.
[h3]Castle Runes & Castles[/h3][list] [*]Castle Runes (a detailed description of the mechanics will be published in a separate document), in brief:[/*][list] [*]At this stage, shards are obtained from regular mobs and bosses;[/*] [*]Small shards can be combined into larger ones, and larger shards into runes—NPCs for this process are marked on the map;[/*] [*]Runes are inserted into Castles, granting bonuses to characters who touch them;[/*] [*]Runes have durability and can be destroyed;[/*] [/list]  [*]The map now displays the current castle phase and a timer for the end of the blue phase;[/*] [*]Tax adjustments:[/*][list] [*]Fixed an issue preventing tax changes on the last day of the in-game month;[/*] [*]Added countdown timers (for both the start and end of the tax adjustment period);[/*] [/list]  [*]Fixed a bug causing karma loss when killing tax evaders;[/*] [/list][h3]Balance (Survivability)[/h3]
[b]Enchantments:[/b]
[list] [*]Large Gear:[/*][list] [*]Bonus to PD/MD significantly increased (by 30% to 100%), opposing stat penalty reduced by 35%[/*] [*]Forced enchantments now have reduced PD/MD penalties.[/*] [/list]  [*]Small Gear:[/*][list] [*]Bonuses to PD/MD increased by approximately 30%;[/*] [/list]  [*]Jewelry:[/*][list] [*]PD/MD bonuses increased by an average of 52%;[/*] [*]HP/MP bonuses increased by an average of 40%;[/*] [/list]  [/list]
[b]Buffs:[/b]
[list] [*]Defensive powder buffs increased in effectiveness by an average of 36%; [/*] [/list]
[b]Druid:[/b]
[list] [*]Group healing powders increased in effectiveness by an average of 23%;[/*] [*]Maximum healing values saw the most significant improvement;[/*] [*]Medium heal range increased by 1.5x;[/*] [*]Added a powerful single-target healing powder (cannot be used on self);[/*] [*]Added a powerful mana restoration powder.[/*] [/list]
[b]Powder Concentration Adjustments and Their Efficacy:[/b]
[list] [*]Group Healing - Druid:[/*][list] [*]Increased effectiveness (higher minimum values);[/*] [*]Increased range;[/*] [*]Reduced mana consumption;[/*] [*]Increased Attribute requirements;[/*] [/list]  [*]HP/MP Restoration Powders:[/*][list] [*]Increased effectiveness (higher minimum values);[/*] [*]Increased Attribute requirements;[/*] [/list]  [*]HP/MP Regeneration Powders:[/*][list] [*]Increased effectiveness (higher minimum values);[/*] [*]Restoration frequency reverted to original values;[/*] [/list]  [*]Concentrated powder yield per brewing increased by 45%;[/*] [/list]
[b]Dispels:[/b]
[list] [*]Base range reduced for dispel powders that remove multiple buffs:[/*][list] [*]By 17% for powders dispeling 2 buffs, by 34% for  powders dispeling 3 buffs;[/*] [/list]  [*]Concentrating dispel powders up to D1 significantly increases requirements;[/*] [/list][h3]Crafting[/h3][list] [*]Item Crafting (Refactor):[/*][list] [*]With the same Crafting Points, crafting higher-quality recipe items is always more efficient for obtaining better-quality items;[/*] [*]Crafting "M" and "O" quality items now requires more Crafting Points (+50% and +20%, respectively);[/*] [/list]  [*]Ehcnantment (Fix):[/*][list] [*]If the recipe quality does not match the item quality, the chance of enchantment failure (receiving a random enchant instead of the intended one) is significantly increased;[/*] [*]Items now always have a chance to break if the recipe quality does not match (50% of the failure chance);[/*] [*]Each excess Crafting Point reduces failure chance by 0.5%.[/*] [/list]  [*]Crafting Points:[/*][list] [*]Tools now provide 50% more Crafting Points;[/*] [*]Professional skills now provide 32% fewer crafting points on average;[/*] [*]Skill cooldowns reduced (especially at higher levels);[/*] [/list]  [*]Fixed:[/*][list] [*]Fixed a bug allowing items to be repaired without consuming ingredients;[/*] [/list]  [/list][h3]Fazira[/h3][list] [*][b]Rewards[/b]:[/*][list] [*]Added 3 types of cloaks (HP +30%, MP +45%, Energy +30% regeneration, including active regen), obtained via Fazira Coins and with low drop chance from the Ice Golem;[/*] [*]Significantly buffed chest armor (now comparable to Solidity/Dragon enchants, no penalties, lower requirements, but lower durability);[/*] [/list]  [*]AI:[/*][list] [*]Fixed an issue with incorrect spider scaling on spawn, causing smaller spiders to miss attacks;[/*] [*]Now spawns 1 of 3 spider types (large, medium, small);[/*] [*]Each type has unique stats, dynamics, and attack effects (slow/dispel/freeze);[/*] [*]"Poison" debuff replaced with "Freezing" (increases cooldowns);[/*] [/list]  [*]Economy:[/*][list] [*]Activated DQB for all Fazira quests and added a taler requirement;[/*] [*]Increased trade quest volume for herb exchanges;[/*] [/list]  [/list][h3]Economy | DQB | DVB | Quests[/h3]
[b]DVB with all NPCs (NPC vendor price adjustments according to supply and demand):[/b]
[list] [*]Fixed a bug causing DBV cooldowns to reset faster than intended ( 3-5 times faster depending on the settlements);[/*] [*]Increased balance currency (for 25% of NPCs);[/*] [*]Slowed down DBV cooldown frequency;[/*] [/list]
[b]Complete Mob Kill Quest Overhaul:[/b]
[list] [*]Average mob kill reward increased 4x;[/*] [*]Quest availability reroll timing adjusted:[/*][list] [*]2x per in-game day in villages;[/*] [*]1x per in-game day in cities;[/*] [*]1x per 2 in-game days for bosses in cities;[/*] [*]20% variance on reroll timing;[/*] [/list]  [*]Cooldown adjustments to reuse quests:[/*][list] [*]4 in-game hours for villages (20 minutes real time);[/*] [*]6 in-game hours for cities (1 hour, 20 minutes);[/*] [*]144 in-game hours for bosses (12 hours);[/*] [/list]  [*]Quest acceptance rules:[/*][list] [*]The current DQB (Dynamic Quest Balance) is locked for the entire quest duration;[/*] [*]Reward variance is not locked, meaning you can take a quest when the reward is low and complete it after a reroll when the reward increases;[/*] [/list]  [*]Quest activation frequency doubled, but each settlement now has unique quest mechanics (details at the end of the patch notes);[/*] [/list]
[b]Economy:[/b]
[list] [*]Increased costs for processing raw materials, crafting jewelry, and producing certain other items.[/*] [*]Fixed an issue where NPCs evaluated mediocre quality items as more valuable than they should be, while high-quality items were undervalued.[/*] [*]Increased quest requirements for profession tiers 4-6 to 150k/300k/500k Thalers; DQB activated.[/*] [*]DVB and DQB have been fully reset (returned to default values);[/*] [/list][h3]Dodging & Energy[/h3][list] [*]Fixed a bug that allowed dodging without cooldown and with reduced energy consumption;[/*] [*]Fixed a bug that “froze” dodge resistance buffs until death/server change;[/*] [*]Dodge changes:[/*][list] [*]Cooldown is now 1.5 sec;[/*] [*]Increased energy cost for repeated dodges within 10 seconds (previously 6 sec);[/*] [*]Increased energy cost for overloaded characters;[/*] [/list]  [*]Energy regeneration: -50% while running, +75% while walking, +100% while standing still;[/*] [/list][h3]UI/UX[/h3][list] [*]Added an outline around icons of enchanted items;[/*] [*]Added/replaced real-time timers in some windows (previously only in-game dates were shown);[/*] [*](Market) Adjusted commission fee descriptions for better readability;[/*] [/list][h3]Cosmetics (Skins)[/h3][list] [*]Gloves added to all armor sets without increasing set costs;[/*] [*]Improved chest armor of the Black Heavy Set;[/*] [*]Fixed item descriptions and inconsistencies regarding which items skins can be applied to;[/*] [*]Fixed first-person skin rendering issues;[/*] [*]Fixed various cases of equipment models clipping through each other;[/*] [*]Added a visual effect for the shop button when new items/discounts appear;[/*] [/list][h3]Added[/h3][list] [*]Map markers for swamps and craters;[/*] [*]Rewards for pioneers for level 60 on NA servers;[/*] [/list][h3]Changed[/h3][list] [*]Nameplate visibility range increased:[/*][list] [*]90m in immersive mode;[/*] [*]60m in classic mode;[/*] [/list]  [*]Controls:[/*][list] [*]Item stack splitting is now back to “Shift” by default;[/*] [*]Item link to chat – “Ctrl”;[/*] [*]Custom keybinding options added for these functions;[/*] [/list]  [*](Currency Market) New restrictions on order volumes introduced;[/*] [/list][h3]Fixed[/h3][list] [*]Chat tab selection now persists when switching servers;[/*] [*]Loot bags rarely falling through the ground;[/*] [*](Market) Case sensitivity in search across different localizations;[/*] [*]Bug that allowed near-infinite order placement on the exchange;[/*] [*]AOE zone in the crater (Oer);[/*] [*]Disconnects when processing large amounts of resources;[/*] [*]Overlapping tax zones (T2 counties);[/*] [/list][h3]Optimized[/h3][list] [*](Client/Server) Nameplate rendering.[/*] [*](Client) Object loading in settlements.[/*] [*](Server) Buff saving and initialization.[/*] [/list][h3]Known Issues:[/h3][list] [*](refactor) NPC names and subnames (roles and types) are not localized;[/*] [*](rare) A floating problem for some users of a number of providers due to the inability to connect to the server without a VPN (our IP addresses periodically get blocked);[/*] [*](medium) A cell disappears from the hotbar (an item in your hands) when switching between servers;[/*] [*](very rare) Incorrect saving of the set of assets “character and containers in real estate” during quick logins/logouts;[/*] [*](rare) Sometimes auto-payment of taxes does not occur;[/*] [/list][h3](Reference) Quest Mechanics by Settlement[/h3][list] [*]General Quest Mechanics:[/*][list] [*]Settlements generally favor 2 monster types – quests notes.title: Update 0.94.1274
notes.content:
Dear friends,

This is the first of a series of big updates we’ve planned for November. 

This month, we are also planning to introduce considerable changes to Vocation balance. Besides, all players will have access to 4-6 stages of Vocations with minimal requirements, but all that’s information for a separate announcement. 

You’ll find day-off fixes and changes at the end of the patch note.
[h3]The Way for All[/h3][list] [*]Experience:[/*][list] [*]Changed the proportion of XP gains in PvE: decreased the final blow XP but increased the overall XP gain;[/*] [*]on average, players will get more XP;[/*] [*]using AOE for leveling will be more effective (but there’ll still be no XP for using buffs);[/*] [/list]  [*]Т5-Т12 containers:[/*][list] [*]A considerable increase of crafter NPC DVB to minimize the effect of demand on prices;[/*] [*]A number of positive changes in the weight and carrying capacity of T8, T10, T11 containers;[/*] [/list]  [/list][h3]The Way for Beginners[/h3][list] [*]Northern T1 Counties:[/*][list] [*]Are wholly filled with lower-level mobs (previously, such spawners were only places around starting villages);[/*] [*]Mob loot drops were updated to match that of mobs from T1 southern counties;[/*] [/list]  [*]Rivulet Island rings:[/*][list] [*]Updated their bonuses to +14;[/*] [*]added quests to get their full set;[/*] [*]these rings can be enchanted;[/*] [/list]  [/list][h3]The Way for Mids[/h3][list] [*]Fazira[/*][list] [*]added another Fazira map for levels 51-60 (the previous 41-60 map is restricted to 41-50);[/*] [*]Fazira spiders now give twice as much XP;[/*] [*]Increased the bonuses Fazira rings give per level from +5 to +12 (e.g., Т6 ring gives +72, Т9 gives +108), but their durability was decreased;[/*] [*]added T7-T9 rings and quests to get them;[/*] [*]a substantial reconsideration of Ice Golem loot drops;[/*] [*]added shading to buff duration to make them readable;[/*] [*]decreased the overall brightness of snow and light sources;[/*] [/list]  [/list][h3]Vocations and abilities:[/h3][list] [*]T2 Vocation stage quests can now be completed at T2 Guides. Only T3 quests have to be picked up and completed at Vocation Teachers beyond settlements;[/*] [*]Added tokens leading to Vocation Teachers who give T3 Vocation quests;[/*] [*]Hunter:[/*][list] [*]by default, gets a passive ability to shoot and reload crossbow while sprinting;[/*] [/list]  [*]Archmage:[/*][list] [*]fly speed increased 3 times, added a visual effect;[/*] [/list]  [*]Thief:[/*][list] [*]“Steal Talers” basic ability was replaced with “Elusiveness”;[/*] [*]The quest that gave “Elusiveness” now gives a new ability — “Pretend”;[/*] [/list]  [*]Anti-invisibility:[/*][list] [*]added a new ability and a quest to get it:[/*][list] [*]applies an affect on a caster that dispels all invisibility effects around them in N radius for n seconds, depleting caster’s HP and MP;[/*] [/list]  [*]Assassin’s Invisibility:[/*][list] [*]allows only 1H sword attacks; 3/4/5 chargers for T1/T2/T3 levels of the ability;[/*] [*]increased duration;[/*] [*]slightly decreased CD;[/*] [/list]  [*]Thief’s Invisibility:[/*][list] [*]1 charge on every stage of the Vocation;[/*] [*]increased duration;[/*] [*]decreased CD;[/*] [/list]  [/list]  [/list][h3]Magic[/h3][list] [*]General:[/*][list] [*]Medium projectiles and AOE (and other magic with long casting time) now use the area or direction that was chosen at the end of its casting time;[/*] [/list]  [*]Pasive HP/MP regeneration powders:[/*][list] [*]250-450% more effective[/*] [*]now have greater requirements;[/*] [*]added R1 concentration—don't dispel on death, longer duration, but they tick 30% less frequently;[/*] [/list]  [*]AOE:[/*][list] [*]Disable sprinting while casting;[/*] [*]Casting time increased to 1,5;[/*] [*]Earth: increased range, speed, decreased CD, added 2 second long stun on hitting a character with the projectile;[/*] [*]Air: increased range, slightly increased CD;[/*] [*]Water: decreased the number of damage ticks, increased the interval between ticks, decreased CD;[/*] [/list]  [*]Dispels:[/*][list] [*]Significantly increased range, speed, and flight speed for tier cycles;[/*] [*]Fixed the wrong radius of the projectile;[/*] [/list]  [*]Air Slow (Wind):[/*][list] [*]Decreased CD;[/*] [/list]  [/list][h3]Refining and Crafting[/h3][list] [*]Recalculated the bonuses for having extra crafting points while crafting and enchanting:[/*][list] [*]extra crafting points give a considerable bonus to item quality within the recipe’s quality range and much lower bonuses beyond it;[/*] [*]the lower the quality of a recipe, the greater the bonus from extra points;[/*] [*]reasonably decreased the bonus for extra crafting points when enchanting items with unmatching recipes;[/*] [/list]  [/list][list] [*]Fixed wrong results of resource refining, including merging and splitting;[/*] [*]Cauldron durability is now visible in both item and brewing widgets;[/*] [*]Fixed using the last point of durability for multiple brewings;[/*] [/list][h3]Addressing Old Issues[/h3][list] [*]Fixed excessive loading of sublevels on the client when entering town and castle zones;[/*] [*]The third-person camera now looks over the shoulder, and the aiming reticle has full functionality;[/*] [*]Fixed incomplete quest progress tracking for gathering quests when filling stacks from different items with varying quality;[/*] [*]Respawning for players with neutral or higher karma in T2 counties now occurs in mini-locations with a Green Zone and teleport (as T2 settlements have not yet been introduced);[/*] [*]Fixed the Cauldrons and tools are less effective than items of similar levels obtained through the game and have lower durability;[/*] [/list]  [*]Upcoming goods:[/*][list] [*]Realty Т1:[/*][list] [*]personal warehouse;[/*] [*]personal libraries with cabinets for recipes;[/*] [*]personal crafting workshops with craft stations;[/*] [/list]  [*]Character slots;[/*] [/list]  [/list]
Best regards, 

Atlant Games Team

notes.title: Update 0.94.1171
notes.content:
Dear friends,

In this update, our main efforts were focused on fixes, rebalancing, and UX improvements. We will also share our plans for the near future.

We have long discussed and delayed this decision but eventually decided that we cannot leave the current game entry threshold as is. Therefore, in this update, we have improved the world map:

notes.title: Update 0.94.1133
notes.content:
Dear friends,
In our new update, we focused on balancing professions, improving castle capture mechanics, and fixing errors.
Additionally, due to the difficulties in transitioning to the free-to-play (F2P) system, we will provide compensation to all players in the form of special food and 4th-level cauldrons.

[b]Added[/b]
[list] [*]Cauldrons up to level 12 have been added. They can be crafted at the alloy smelter.
There are two types: lightweight portable cauldrons weighing 5 kg and heavy stationary cauldrons weighing 15 kg.
The amount of powder produced per brew has been increased by 96%. On average, each cauldron gives 119% more powder.
These improvements are part of a broader initiative to simplify life on the continent, which also includes increasing the spawn rate of herbs and marked areas on the map.[/*][/list]
[b]Changes[/b]
[list] [*]The flight speed of the crossbow bolt has been increased by 30%.[/*] [*]The accuracy of the crossbow bolt has been increased by 15%.
Due to changed priorities, we were unable to allocate time to AMMO crossbow within the planned timeframe, so we have brought the speed and accuracy of the bolt in line with our expectations for the future "Light" bolt.[/*][*]The stacking of bleeding effects from unnamed monsters has been removed.
Currently, there is no evasion and damage in relative terms from maximum HP, which reduces the effectiveness of tank builds and unnecessarily complicates the game for new players.[/*][*]Experience in PvE has been increased by 25%, including a 25% increase in experience for the final blow.
The motivation behind this change is to make the game more accessible and easier for new players, as well as less punishing.[/*][/list]
[b]Castle Capture Changes[/b]
[list] [*]It is now forbidden to fill level 15 and 45 castles with royal elixirs.[/*] [*]The time for filling castles with regular elixirs has been reduced by 32%.[/*] [*]The maximum time is 16 hours for any castle level and any elixir.[/*] [*]The time for filling castles with royal elixirs has been reduced by 24%.[/*] [*]The maximum time is 48 hours for level 30 and 60 castles.[/*] [*]The cost of creating castle elixirs has been changed to more accurately reflect their value in terms of the duration of the blue phase of castle ownership.[/*] [*]The duration of the red phase has been reduced by 50%.[/*] [*]Level 15: from 45 to 57.5 minutes depending on the elixir level.[/*] [*]Level 60: from 55 to 67.5 minutes for regular elixirs, and from 65 to 90 minutes for royal elixirs.[/*] [*]The burning of forts has been reduced to 2 minutes (up to 90% depending on the castle level).[/*] [*]The HP of fort gates has been increased by 50-100%.[/*][/list]
With 24 available castles, our actions are aimed at increasing dynamics, reducing time intervals, and intensifying events.
Meanwhile, we highlight the recent addition of publicly available information about the start of the red phase and its upcoming addition to the game map.
The originally planned mechanics of prolonged fort burning, serving as a buffer before the rapid loss of a castle for its owners, will be further developed within the framework of the castle grade.

[b]Error Fixes[/b]
[list] [*]The abilities of northerners that did not apply debuffs correctly have been fixed.[/*] [*]The repeated giving of quests by trainers after their completion has been fixed.[/*] [*]The chat error where messages were not displayed has been fixed.[/*] [*]The absence of a cooldown for invincibility when re-entering the game has been fixed.[/*] [*]The error where the PvP invincibility buff was not applied on the starting island has been fixed.[/*] [*]The quality mark has been removed from items that should not have it.[/*] [/list]
[b]Vocation Balance Changes[/b]

We have made significant changes to vocation bonuses.

Our approach:
[list] [*]Rejection of unified bonuses;[/*] [*]Priority of bonuses over penalties;[/*] [*]Overall increase in vocation bonuses.[/*] [/list]
In connection with these changes, we will also provide free redistribution points corresponding to your current character level.

The full list of changes can be [url=https://reignofguilds.com/en/news/20241001-02/]found on our website[/url] .

[url=https://discord.com/invite/45HsGGQpqG][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/716350/extras/0.jpg?t=1712780458[/img][/url]

notes.title: Try Reign of Guilds for free
notes.content:
Dear friends, 

Today we are making a huge step for our project — making it freely accessible for everyone. 

[i]Unfortunately, it took us far more time to negotiate all the terms of free access with Steam than we had expected. We also were denied the “Free Weekend” programme. But we still found a way around this situation.[/i]

[b]Why free access?[/b]
[list] [*]just like you we realize that the world of Reign of Guilds cannot develop with its current online even taking into account that Steam doesn’t include the number of players from all platforms;[/*] [*]we’ve said it more than once that we want to give new players a chance to try the game for free, at least in the confines of tutorial locations (Rivulet Island);[/*] [/list]
[b]What are the limitations of the free version?[/b]
[list] [*]Only 1 character per account;[/*] [*]Restrictions on the exit from Rivulet Island;[/*] [*]Greater progression of the Island Tax;[/*] [*]Can’t create guilds;[/*] [*]Can’t use customization items (skins and animations);[/*] [/list]
[b]Restrictions on the exit from Rivulet Island?[/b]
[list] [*]We still made it possible for the players with the free version of the game to leave the island after completing a quest for each character on the account;[/*] [*]We think that all the players who want to try the mainland should have this opportunity;[/*] [*]Basically, it gives people the possibility to play the game for free;[/*] [/list]
[b]What is Rivulet Island at this moment?[/b]
[list] [*]As a rule, new players spend 30 to 50 hours to leave the island with their first character;[/*] [*]The island gives opportunity to learn the game mechanics in nearly absolute safety and get yourself beginner money and equipment;[/*] [*]To make the beginners’ experience even richer, we’ve reworked the crafting system in several previous patches, making it available from level 1 on with any Vocation, and adding all that is necessary for it on the island;[/*] [/list]
[b]DLC “Commoner” and DLC “Knight”?[/b]
[list] [*]DLC “Commoner” was added to lower the threshold for players who want to enter the kingdom of Dwarrhan. It is relatively cheap but still includes a number of restrictions;[/*] [*]DLC “Knight” is distributed to all the players who purchased the base game earlier. It is a version of the game free of any limitations;[/*] [/list]
[b]Summing up[/b]

This step is very important for our project, and we did as much as we could to add the free version of the game in such a way so that the former base game (currently DLC “Knight”) doesn’t lose its value. 

To draw the line, we’d like to add that we are going to spend a good half of our time to improve the beginner experience of our game, working on the tutorial locations, quests, map, and making easier a number of core game routines.

With all due respect,

Atlant Games team

But we still found a way around this situation.

we’ve said it more than once that we want to give new players a chance to try the game for free, at least in the confines of tutorial locations (Rivulet Island);
Only 1 character per account;
Restrictions on the exit from Rivulet Island;
Greater progression of the Island Tax;
Can’t create guilds;
Can’t use customization items (skins and animations);
We still made it possible for the players with the free version of the game to leave the island after completing a quest for each character on the account;
We think that all the players who want to try the mainland should have this opportunity;
Basically, it gives people the possibility to play the game for free;
As a rule, new players spend 30 to 50 hours to leave the island with their first character;
The island gives opportunity to learn the game mechanics in nearly absolute safety and get yourself beginner money and equipment;

To make the beginners’ experience even richer, we’ve reworked the crafting system in several previous patches, making it available from level 1 on with any Vocation, and adding all that is necessary for it on the island;
DLC “Commoner” was added to lower the threshold for players who want to enter the kingdom of Dwarrhan. It is relatively cheap but still includes a number of restrictions;
DLC “Knight” is distributed to all the players who purchased the base game earlier. It is a version of the game free of any limitations;

This step is very important for our project, and we did as much as we could to add the free version of the game in such a way so that the former base game (currently DLC “Knight”) doesn’t lose its value.

To draw the line, we’d like to add that we are going to spend a good half of our time to improve the beginner experience of our game, working on the tutorial locations, quests, map, and making easier a number of core game routines.

notes.title: Update 0.94.1108
notes.content:
Dear friends,
As part of our latest update, we have focused on expanding the functionality by introducing a ratings table and the ability to view monster locations on the geographical map.
Additionally, we have carefully addressed reports of issues and successfully resolved a number of existing errors.

[b]What's new:[/b]
[list] [*]A general leaderboard that tracks:
- Player statistics (level, kills, karma, etc.);
- Guilds (capital, number of members, kills, rating, etc.);
- Castles (level, owner, set taxes, amount of taxes collected);[/*][/list]
[u]This statistics can be viewed at any time by clicking the button in the top right corner of the screen;[/u]
[list] [*]Icons for monster spawn locations on the map.
 Some time ago, we introduced the "spot" game. Forests where a certain type of mob is more likely to spawn than in other places. These locations will now be marked with special icons on the map for better navigation in the world;[/*] [/list]

notes.title: Update 0.94.1071
notes.content:
Dear friends,

This update is the first in a series of significant changes to the game, which we plan to complete by October.

[b][u]Crafting[/u][/b]

Accessibility:
[list] [*]Crafting/enchanting is available for characters of any level, regardless of profession.[/*] [*]Everything needed for weapon crafting, but without enchanting for now, has been added to Stream Island, along with training quests.[/*] [*]Crafting and enchanting high-level and quality items will still require specialized professions.[/*] [/list]
Complete overhaul of crafting/enchanting point calculations:
[list] [*]The required degree of crafting/enchanting now depends on not only the item level but also the desired quality, based on recipe quality.
For example, a CCC item of level 9 requires 243 crafting points.[/*][/list][list] [*]Each factor affecting the actual number of crafting points has been completely reworked, and the proportion now looks roughly like this:[list] [*]Profession - 17%[/*] [*]Skills - 41%[/*] [*]Workbenches - 17%[/*] [*]Tools - 25% (the number of tool levels will be increased to 12)[/*] [/list] [/*] [/list]
Enchanting recipes:
[list] [*]Now also have 4 tiers for more even distribution among mobs of different tiers.[/*] [*]The drop rate of enchanting recipes from mobs has been changed.[/*] [/list]
Unchanged:
[list] [*]Exceeding the required crafting points still increases the quality of the crafted item.[/*] [*]Repair requires fewer points than crafting, restoration requires more.[/*] [/list]
Fixed:
[list] [*]Incorrect calculation of required points for enchanting.[/*] [*]Lack of recipes in the drop for certain weapons.[/*] [*]Recipe descriptions.[/*] [*]Quest for the 3rd level of concentrated weapon crafting.[/*] [/list]
[u][b]Castles[/b][/u]

Added:
[list] [*]Notifications about the castle/point owner in the upper right corner (under the location name).[/*] [*]For all players on the castle territory - about the siege progress in the upper right corner (from gate damage to castle capture).[/*] [*]Notifications in a new section of the global chat - about changes in castle phases (currently default for all castles).[/*] [*]In the future, there will be an option to enable and disable duplicate messages on the screen for world/castle event notifications.[/*] [/list]
Fixed:
[list] [*]Notification errors for castle owners coming to the guild chat channel.[/*] [*]Design errors of the Kreade castle.[/*] [*]Dimension errors of AI spawners in the Ufford castle.[/*] [*]Dimension errors of capture points in the Gwal castle.[/*] [*]Extra spawners of regular mobs on T2 castle territories.[/*] [/list]
Reference:
[list] [*]While castle Runes are in development, which will add meaning to castle ownership, we want to improve the capture procedure for participants and owners outside the castle and make sieges more massive, accessible, and understandable.[/*] [*]In the future, we will revisit the issue of the necessity and harm of castle public openness.[/*] [/list]
[u][b]T2 Counties[/b][/u]

Added:
[list] [*]Cemeteries in Gwal, Gwelot, Mennitz, and Unsund.[/*] [*]Roads.[/*] [*]11 extraction/processing locations with partial filling.[/*] [*]Bosses and their drops in Gwal.[/*] [/list]
Changed:
[list] [*]Fence separating counties.[/*] [/list]
[u][b]Miscellaneous[/b][/u]

Changed:
[list] [*]PvP experience increased by x3.[/*] [*]Improved UX of the world map.[/*] [/list]
Fixed:
[list] [*]Buffs dealing damage on crater tops.[/*] [*]Icons for crossbows T7-T9.[/*][/list]



Thank you for your patience and support. We will share our plans for the next patches in a separate message.



Sincerely,

The Atlant Games Team

notes.title: What’s Next?
notes.content:
Dear friends, 
we send this message to tell you about the changes in the game that we are currently working on—changes that were not included in the roadmap 3 months ago and have been given a higher priority.

From the perspective of the developers, these changes will help us breathe new life into the project for those who've been playing it for hundreds of hours, attract new players, and provide them with a quicker immersion into the game.

[b]1. Healthier game enviromnent[/b]
[list]
[*]Recently, we’ve posted a message about starting to have stricter control over what’s happening in the game and launched a first wave of bans for the abuse of game mechanics.
[*]This week we’ve searched through the game logs (over 25 GB) looking for data about abusing the levelling system this August. Some accounts have already received permanent bans, but the majority of offenders will be dealt with after we’ve finished working with logs.
[/list]

[b]2. Statistics[/b]
[list]
[*]Public boards with statistics on characters, guilds, and castles.
[*]The first stage of its development will be PvP-orientated and will gather the metrics that have been in the project since its release.
[/list]

[b]3. Castles[/b]
[list]
[*]The first stage is to make notifications for castle owners and all players on the castle territory about the seige process.
[*]The second stage will be to make castle crystals as a first step to adding rewards for capturing castles.
[/list]

[b]4. Crafting[/b]
[list]
[*]For starters, crafting will become available for all characters. But we’ll change the allocation of the crafting points, which will mean that players without specialization will not be able to create high-quality items.
[*]Enchantment recipes will be divided into tiers, just like crafting recipes. As a result, we’ll change the recipe drops from mobs and bosses.
[/list]

[b]5. Inferiority of single Vocations and changes to the mage economy[/b]
[list]
We’ll arrange the changes in the order of adding them to the game:

[*]introduction of level 10–12 rings before all other Т4 equipment (perhaps, revision of their bonuses to make them more powerful).
[*]introduction of the full mage gear set (hats, pants, gloves, etc.).
[*]revision of bonuses for single Vocations: decreasing or completely removing the maluses from the locked development branch.
[*]increasing the amount of powders made in a single brewing and reconsidering the benefits of concentrated powders
[*]a global overhaul of the ability system (1+4 slots). We’ll increase the number of ability slots and remove a forced vocation ability. Beside that, we plan to introduce “skill points.” A fixed value determined by the vocation to choose what abilities you can use.
[*]This system will be used to further assist single Vocations. “Intelligent” Archmages will have more skill points than “dumb” Barbarians, which will help them to use a wider repertoire of “expensive” abilities.
[/list]

[b]6. Trial access and new players[/b]
[list]
[*]We are looking for the most optimal way to make the game free for new players, at least within Rivulet Island.
[*]The next step will be to overhaul the starting quest chain at the beginning of the game and improve the UX to make acquaintance with the game easier.
[/list]

[b]7. Steam, VKPlay Early Pre-Order rewards[/b]
[list]
[*]after the introduction of the trial version of the game, we’ll allow players to move characters from their Steam account to VK Play account.
[*]activation of Early Pre-Order rewards.
[/list]

These are not all the diversions from the roadmap, but they are the main ones. We plan to also add all T2 castles at the same time as the introduction of castle crystals.

ROG’ums Up!

notes.title: Questions and Answers from the community
notes.content:
[b]How exactly will Archmages be balanced, what bonuses will special equipment provide, and how will staves work?[/b]  

    [i]The balance of Vocations is determined by the overall picture, not by individual classes. Currently, the balance is in a poor state. We will correct it in the future, but it's not our highest priority right now. Special equipment will not be introduced anytime soon, so there’s nothing to say about it yet.[/i]
[i]We have several concepts for how staves will work, but since there is almost no code ready for them, there’s nothing to share at the moment.[/i]  

    [b]After T6 gear, will T9 and T12 be introduced simultaneously or sequentially? When can we expect T9?[/b]  

    [i]Tiers above T6 will be introduced step by step, as they appear in the armor recipes. They will be released sequentially. T9 is already in the game. T10-12 will appear along with T3 counties.[/i]  

    [b]Will a protection system like VAC or Frost Game Guard be added to the game?[/b]  

    [i]We would very much like to add such a protection system, but they cost a lot of money, which the project currently does not have.[/i]  

    [b]When will castle items, crystals, county taxes, and other perks from owning a castle, besides passage tax, be added?[/b]  

    [i]Everything is in the roadmap: the Count is planned for the next chapter. Bonuses from owning castles will come before that.[/i]  

    [b]When will the functionality to upgrade a castle to receive the above-mentioned perks be introduced?[/b]  

    [i]The answer is above. We plan to implement it before introducing the Count.[/i]  

    [b]It’s already the 5th month since the game’s release in Early Access. The issue with invisibility abilities for the thief and assassin hasn’t been resolved. These are the only abilities in the game that have no counter! Until when? Just make it like it was in Sphere - an ability or powder to see invisibility, let it work within a 20-meter radius at least. You may say - but we have a special anti-invisibility ability! Yes, it exists, but it doesn’t change the situation because it’s useless, as it’s impossible to protect against invisibility with it. There should be a counter, and the price of this counter should be an ability and a slot occupied in buffs; I think that would be fair.[/b]  

    [i]We plan to rework this skill, and it will be included in future updates.[/i]  

    [b]When will zlatys be introduced, and will there be an option to buy skins with zlatys and transfer them to other players for use without DLCs?[/b]  

    [i]Zlates will certainly be added, but it’s hard to say when exactly. You will definitely be able to buy cosmetics with them and use them, of course, without DLCs.[/i]  

    [b]When will the issue of skills disappearing from the hotbar be fixed?[/b]  

    [i]It’s in progress. We are prioritizing bugs that break balance or core functionality.[/i]  

    [b]When will the infinite stamina bug be fixed? It's been present since the game's launch, and I'm curious what technical issues prevent it from being resolved?[/b]  

    [i]We fixed the bug, but apparently, we didn’t find all the ways to use it and missed something. We’ll try to fix it soon.[/i]  

    [b]After which point(s) on the roadmap will you be able to say that the core mechanics necessary for balancing and long-term player retention are ready?[/b]  

    [i]There are currently over 300 hours of game content for players who enjoy the game. The issue now is attracting and retaining new players. It’s more about adding Quality of Life mechanics, improving core gameplay, and marketing.[/i]  

    [b]Are there plans to add new equipment slots soon?[/b]  

    [i]Not in the near future.[/i]  

    [b]Have you considered adding T6.5 items: enchanted gear with a 150-200 MA bonus, for example? Maybe add them to castles and Fazira, creating a long grind for them. This would already create interest and a goal for further play.[/b]  

    [i]We’ve already added items above the 6th tier. An update to Fazira will come with them.[/i]  

    [b]On what basis are classes balanced? Only usage statistics and internal 1v1 tests? Maybe it’s worth selecting active PvP players, giving them specific classes, and conducting 10v10 battles for better class balance?[/b]  

    [i]Class balance is achieved by:[/i]  
[list]      [*]    
    [i]Normalizing balance (calculating abstract class power);[/i]  
  [/*][*]    
    [i]Manual testing;[/i]  
  [/*][*]    
    [i]Statistics;[/i]  
  [/*][*]    
    [i]10v10 manual battles are a drop in the ocean for balancing. The build system is too extensive to rely on such incomplete data.[/i]  
  [/*]    [/list]
    [b]Could you briefly explain the concept behind the classes, or at least the roles of single mages, single physicals, and multis? Ideally, we’d get a text description of the concept and role of each class in the game.[/b]  

    [i]It’s a long explanation, but in short:[/i]  
[list]      [*]    
    [i]Physical and magical classes are specialists who can wear narrowly specialized builds: glass cannon, very tanky tanks, etc.[/i]  
  [/*][*]    
    [i]Hybrids are generalists. They can do a bit of everything but not as effectively as singles.[/i]  
  [/*][*]    
    [i]Right now, balance doesn't work this way, but we plan to fix it. Of course, hybrids shouldn’t dominate everything.[/i]  
  [/*]    [/list]
    [b]When are activities/competitions/contests/events planned in the game/on the forum/in Discord?[/b]  

    [i]We are planning several in-game events, but we cannot specify a date yet.[/i]  

    [b]Regarding the merging of the American and European servers, has this idea been postponed indefinitely? What will the ping be like in Russia if this happens?[/b]  

    [i]The ping will be bad. Merging servers was never part of our plans; it was rather an idea that surfaced in the community due to low server populations.[/i]  

    [b]Will such in-game statistics be available for everyone?[/b]  

    [i]We are currently working on it.[/i]  

    [b]Would it be better not to give out anything at all, and if rewarding, to do so with something more valuable at least?[/b]  

    [i]Tell us what you would like to receive as rewards? We tried to provide a reward that makes sense but doesn’t create an imbalance in the game.[/i]  

    [b]Can the level restriction on skins be removed?[/b]  

    [i]It’s already been removed.[/i]  

    [b]Is it possible to make information about tickets processed based on our reports open (Ticket number ATL-2445)?[/b]  

    [i]We won’t make such information public. If a ticket has been assigned a number, it means it's already in our system. The more reports or confirmations of its relevance, the faster it gets the corresponding priority and reaches us for processing.[/i]  

    [b]Friends list? Quality of life updates? (the map is awful) Small touches to existing systems? (combat, looting...)[/b]  

    [i]In the course of development, we are trying to improve the design of many mechanics and add those that make life easier for players.[/i]  

    [b]Will most of the points in the June-August roadmap be completed by the end of July?[/b]  

    [i]Most likely, by the end of August.[/i]  

    [b]Will the new third-person combat feature be revisited?[/b]  

    [i]Most likely, no. It was a deliberate decision to attract a larger audience. Nevertheless, the third-person view will be refined for better balance and usability.[/i]  

    [b]Do NPC enemies work correctly now? It seems that any non-boss NPC can be killed without taking damage if you dodge in time, etc. Is this a designed game mechanic or an exploit?[/b]  

    [i]By "exploit," we mean systematically using errors/bugs/dupes/shortcomings to your advantage. If a mob has such a simple move set that it's easy to kite, then killing it without taking damage is perfectly legal. However, if you are making the mob get stuck in meshes or intentionally bugging it in some other way without filing a bug report, that’s a rules violation. There’s an obvious difference between the simplicity of a mob and using errors to exploit it.[/i]  

    [b]With the game's transition from Steam to VK Play, are plans for development outside the CIS market, server mergers, etc., canceled? Will we be playing in our small company, or how will reaching a new audience outside the CIS be implemented?[/b]  

    [i]The departure from Steam only affects the Russian region. Moreover, the servers where players from Russia play still include players from the CIS and Europe, as the server remains Eurasian. The same distribution model that was in place before will remain for all other countries.[/i]  

    [b]When will T7-T9 rings appear?[/b]  

    [i]They’re already available.[/i]  

    [b]When will full-fledged content for levels 30-60 be introduced?[/b]  

    [i]Content for level 30 appears in T2 counties. Content for levels 45-60 will be in T3 counties, which will follow T2.[/i]
